name: Arti Kumari

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Arti Kumari writes poetry in Hindi and English and is also a ghazal writer and editor. Her collections include धड़कनों का संगीत and साथ रखना है. She has edited ये नए मिज़ाज का शहर है and बिहार की महिला ग़ज़लकार, while Rekhta carries a selection of her ghazals. Reviewing धड़कनों का संगीत in Setu, Subhash Pathak “Ziya” draws attention to the meeting of love and social protest in her work.

Her Kabita Live poem True love speaks in direct, rhyming appeals. It sets love outside the calculation of profit and loss, then moves towards devotion, vulnerability and giving. The final images of melting ice and a disappearing drop carry its idea of surrender into the natural world.
